evals.prompt: I need to containerize this Spring Boot application for deployment on OpenShift. It's currently running on a VM and connects to a PostgreSQL database, has file uploads that go to /var/app/uploads, and uses application.properties for configuration. The codebase is already indexed with rgctl (rgctl -f json metrics --pagerank works). Can you create a production-ready container setup with Red Hat UBI images, including the Dockerfile, OpenShift manifests, and security hardening? Make sure database credentials go into secrets and the upload directory becomes a persistent volume.
evals.expected_output: Complete containerization package: Dockerfile using UBI OpenJDK image, OpenShift manifests (Deployment, Service, Route, ConfigMap, Secret, PVC for uploads, StatefulSet for PostgreSQL), security hardening (non-root, read-only FS, vulnerability scan), podman-compose for local dev, and containerization report documenting graph findings and deployment instructions.

evals.prompt: We're moving our Django application to OpenShift containers. It uses PostgreSQL for data, Redis for caching, and calls an external payment API. Currently everything is hardcoded in settings.py including the database URL and API keys. I've already run rgctl discover so the analysis exists. Containerize this with Red Hat UBI Python images - I need the database and Redis running in OpenShift too, with all secrets properly secured. Also need a way to test locally with podman.

evals.prompt: Our legacy Java application on bare metal needs to move to OpenShift. It's a mess - hardcoded Oracle connection strings, writes logs to /opt/app/logs, has scheduled Quartz jobs, and loads properties from /etc/myapp/config.properties. The codebase has been analyzed with rgctl already. Containerize it with Red Hat UBI, but we'll use an external managed Oracle database instead of running it in OpenShift. Handle all the platform-specific stuff, make it secure, and give me deployment instructions.
evals.expected_output: Containerization package addressing legacy issues: Dockerfile with UBI OpenJDK and multi-stage build, refactored configuration to use ENV variables and ConfigMap, logs redirected to stdout, Quartz jobs configured for container environment, OpenShift manifests with external database reference in Secret, emptyDir volumes for temp/cache, security hardening, podman build and test instructions, and migration report documenting all platform-specific code changes required.
